newsitem.title: USA: Kodak's Fisher says not leaving company.
newsitem.headline: Kodak's Fisher says not leaving company.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co. Chairman and Chief Executive Officer George Fisher, who has been mentioned as a possible successor to AT&T. Corp. chief Robert Allen, said Friday he is committed to staying with the imaging giant at least through the year 2000.

"I will remain with Kodak through the successful conclusion of the investments we are making in Kodak's future," he said in a statement. "Let me make it clear in the strongest terms: I will not leave Kodak until my work is done."

Kodak said Fisher issued the statement in response to media speculation that he is a candidate to succeed Allen instead of John Walter, who resigned Wednesday as AT&T president after being informed by the telecommunication giant's board of directors that he would not be elevated to CEO.
Kodak's stock fell 25 cents to $66 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
